fluff.overview: Despite the low regard most Clans hold for conventional infantry, these formations benefit from incidental access to Clan technology that makes even a disaffected garrison Point a match for its Inner Sphere equivalent. Mechanized Hover Points ride hovercraft that provide the fastest ground speed of any infantry transport, with the added capability of crossing water obstacles. This speed comes at the cost of durability, as hovercraft are fragile compared to tracked or wheeled vehicles, but in open terrain or coastal environments, few formations can match their ability to reposition quickly. Support troops operate man-portable long-range missile launchers capable of engaging targets at distances well beyond personal weapon range, providing the Point with indirect fire capability against vehicles and fortified positions.
